easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Lagrella until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
